description.en: The AccessKey ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
The name of the multicloud account.

description.zh:
多云的code。取值：
- aliyun：阿里云
- hcloud：华为云
- qcloud：腾讯云
description.en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud
- hcloud: Huawei Cloud
- qcloud: Tencent Cloud

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select a region for the data management center based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are deployed in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are deployed in regions outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member to whose view the administrator switches.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The type of the view.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem bind-account --access-id ABCXXXXXXXX --account-name xxxx --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem BindAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --AccessId ABCXXXXXXXX --RoleType 1 --RoleFor 1130916744880000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccountName xxxx
